item.title: LLM Wiki: Compiled Knowledge RAG Cannot Replace
item.description: RAG became the default answer to giving models external knowledge: chunk, embed, retrieve at query time, generate. Useful — and overused. RAG optimizes access, not representation: it finds fragments but builds no stable domain understanding, retrieves context but never decides the canonical explanation. An LLM Wiki moves synthesis to ingest time, compiling sources into structured, linked, human-readable knowledge before any question arrives.
